Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 40
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator introduced an unverified “educated guess” that the Chicago landmark was Willis Tower and the firm was Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, then pursued that path without confirming the APOD clue. The correct trail from the early-August 2015 APOD (showing the lights of Marquette, Michigan) should have led to Chicago’s Marquette Building, designed by Holabird & Roche (firm name as of June 2023: Holabird & Root), making the correct first name “Holabird.” The premature, unverified assumption directly caused the wrong final answer “Skidmore.”
